svg.text: TorchIO 2: fix every place the library drifted from its documentation
TorchIO loads, augments and patch-samples 3D medical images for PyTorch. Its code no longer does what its own pages and docstrings say. The agent finds each
disagreement and changes the code, never the documentation.
